title: The Message That Outlived Its Maker
scaffold_note: Decision scaffold assembled 2026-10-26 (JOB MIGRATION-3) from eo-ep3's own records only. A field the records do not settle ships OPEN with an empty rationale — intent is never invented. Coverage wording: every count in this package is a count of recorded decisions with reasons, not an observation of the rendered result.

objective.value: Chapter three of how information evolved on Earth: show the third archive — a mark on a wall, the first message stored outside every living body, still speaking to strangers forty thousand years after its maker died.
objective.rationale: The series spine applied to threshold 3 (STRUCT-2 H5, decided); the script doc's occasion frames the same claim — the hand stencil as the first message that needed no living carrier.
objective.source: archer reasoning (script docs v2/v3 + STRUCT-2 audit, 2026-10-24)

message.value: "About 40,000 years ago, people began leaving marks on cave walls — and for the first time, information could live outside every living body and speak to strangers long after its maker was gone." (Essence, ≤8 words: 'A mark can outlive its maker.')
message.rationale: The one learning sentence (T-17); the v2 cold restatement matched it and passed. The doc itself logs the distinction between the sentence's 'for the first time' (the category shift) and the spoken lines' 'one of the first' (the claim fix) — a decision, not a slip.

story_structure.value: Problem–Agitation–Solution (a deliberate variation from Ep.1/Ep.2's And–But–Therefore). PROBLEM: every message so far needs a living carrier (L3). AGITATION: carriers die; when the last rememberer dies, the message dies (L4). SOLUTION: put the message on the wall, where it waits for strangers (L5–L7) — at a price named in L8–L9 (it cannot travel). Villain (N-06), named: the dying witness. Intended feeling: unease in the dark of the cave, then awe.
story_structure.rationale: Declared in the v2 script doc's narrative declaration (N-04/N-06/N-03, carried from v1, re-checked against v2 lines) and built unchanged in v3/v4.

hook_form.value: Prediction hook (N-01): L1 shows an act finishing — a hand pressed flat, red dust blown over it, the time anchor ('forty thousand years ago') at the END of the line — whose completion is not predictable: the setup reads as art; the payoff is storage, a message that needs no living carrier (L5, L7). Payoff lines named: L2 (the reveal), L7 (the statement). Cold test: PASS.
hook_form.rationale: Logged in the v2 Phase 1 Narrative Gate (N-01 first-line cold test, PASS); the v2 opener was rewritten action-first with the reason recorded in both Ep.3's and Ep.4's scripts (differentiate from Ep.4's temporal opener) — STRUCT-2 H1 scores it EXEMPLARY.
